title: First Match
goal: Two commands. One carries a number, the other carries nothing.
hints: One arm needs a name for the number it is given.
explanation: `Command::Add(n)` binds the carried number to `n`, which the arm then adds to the total. `Command::Reset` carries nothing, so it has no brackets, and it produces zero. Both arms produce an `i32`, which they must, because the `match` is the function's return value.
